correctness.rationale: Exact Hessian factorization yields twelve reduced reflection lines; six simple flex contacts per line and group transitivity give 72 distinct tangent lines. The orbit is lifted in Z[omega,r], with all 264 additional concurrence determinant identities tested coefficientwise in characteristic zero. Reduction at omega=14,r=29 modulo 211 only excludes extra intersections and proves distinctness. Complete pair count 2556; exact modular partition 12 x 6, 216 x 3, 1728 x 2; each line 1 sixfold, 9 triples, 48 doubles. The defining sextic is smooth and the residue embedding is justified by irreducibility of r^6-10r^3+1 over Q(omega). Both included programs executed successfully.

value.rationale: Computes the complete natural intersection lattice of a symmetry-invariant line arrangement of 72 inflection tangents to a distinguished smooth genus-ten sextic. The 216 triple points, 12 sixfold clusters and 1728 ordinary nodes are not forced by knowing the 12 reflection lines or generic Plucker totals; each tangent has a uniform (1,9,48) incidence type. This is a concrete structural invariant with plausible further applications to arrangement geometry without claiming an unproved downstream result.
